document: IStructE/Concrete Society SMDS Chapters 1–5 — General Detailing Rules
rule_type: General — applies to all members unless overridden by member-specific chapter

decision_rules.name: column_bar_link_retention
decision_rules.condition: distance between column bars > 150mm
decision_rules.action: Every column bar must be retained by a link

decision_rules.name: column_bar_link_retention_close_spacing
decision_rules.condition: distance between column bars <= 150mm
decision_rules.action: Every other column bar should be retained by a link

decision_rules.name: straight_bar_preference
decision_rules.condition: any bar in any element
decision_rules.action: Use straight bars wherever possible
decision_rules.rationale: Easier to detail, supply and fix than bars with bends

decision_rules.name: bar_max_length_12mm_plus
decision_rules.condition: bar nominal diameter >= 12mm
decision_rules.action: Schedule with maximum length of 12m

decision_rules.name: bar_max_length_10mm_less
decision_rules.condition: bar nominal diameter <= 10mm
decision_rules.action: Schedule with maximum length of 6m

decision_rules.name: hole_not_on_rebar_drawing_circular
decision_rules.condition: circular hole in slab or wall, diameter <= 150mm
decision_rules.action: Need not be indicated on reinforcement drawings

decision_rules.name: hole_not_on_rebar_drawing_rectangular
decision_rules.condition: rectangular hole in slab or wall, size <= 150x150mm
decision_rules.action: Need not be indicated on reinforcement drawings

decision_rules.name: hole_on_rebar_drawing_large
decision_rules.condition: hole larger than 150mm diameter (circular) or 150x150mm (rectangular)
decision_rules.action: Must be indicated on reinforcement drawing AND trimmed where necessary by suitable bars

decision_rules.name: secondary_beam_lever_arm_check
decision_rules.condition: secondary beam reinforcement has increased top cover
decision_rules.action: Check resulting reduction in lever arm is satisfactory

decision_rules.name: bottom_span_bars_stop_at_column
decision_rules.condition: internal beam/column intersection with preformed cages
decision_rules.action: Bottom span bars stop short of column face; bottom span bars must not extend into column

decision_rules.name: link_hanger_bars_stop_at_column
decision_rules.condition: internal beam/column intersection
decision_rules.action: Link hanger bars stop short of column face

decision_rules.name: vibrator_access_at_beam
decision_rules.condition: any beam with column or formwork
decision_rules.action: Allow 75mm space for vibrator for every 300mm of beam width

decision_rules.name: cross_ties_for_link_height
decision_rules.condition: link free height would otherwise exceed 400mm
decision_rules.action: Provide cross ties at 1000mm centres to limit free height of link to 400mm

decision_rules.name: column_crank_ratio
decision_rules.condition: column bars cranked at change of section
decision_rules.action: Crank ratio 1:10 (1 horizontal : 10 vertical)
decision_rules.note: Check cranked bars do not foul any other reinforcement

decision_rules.name: u_bars_for_external_beam_column
decision_rules.condition: beam connects to edge/external column
decision_rules.action: U-bars may be used; must be positioned as close to far face of column as possible
decision_rules.sequence: U-bars installed after lower column cast, before beam cage placed

decision_rules.name: precast_cover_verification
decision_rules.condition: precast concrete element with congested reinforcement
action: Check cover on drawing against assumed in calculation
Check cover to reinforcement actually achieved on site

decision_rules.name: chamfer_fillet_cover_check
decision_rules.condition: chamfers or fillets present on concrete section
decision_rules.action: Check if chamfers and fillets affect cover to reinforcement

decision_rules.name: nominal_reinforcement_default
decision_rules.condition: Designer has not given instruction for a particular detail or nominal reinforcement
decision_rules.action: Detailer assumes standards described in this manual apply

decision_rules.name: early_fixed_reinforcement_detailing_assignment
decision_rules.condition: reinforcement needs to be fixed in one part before being concreted
decision_rules.action: Detail that reinforcement with that part (e.g. starters from tank floor into walls detailed with the floor)

decision_rules.name: beam_to_column_clearance
decision_rules.condition: beam/column intersection detailing
decision_rules.action: Beam reinforcement must avoid column reinforcement, which is likely cast into concrete before beam reinforcement is fixed

decision_rules.name: beam_to_beam_layer_clearance
decision_rules.condition: beam/beam intersection
decision_rules.action: Layers of reinforcement in each beam must be arranged so they will pass over each other with correct cover to upper and lower layers

decision_rules.name: slab_to_beam_top_steel_cover
decision_rules.condition: slab-to-beam intersection
decision_rules.action: Cover over reinforcement in beam must be sufficient for top steel in slab to pass over beam with correct cover

checks: Is spacing of reinforcement correct both on plan and section?
Is the cover specified and correct?
Are splices and laps in correct position?
Are cranks required where bars cross?
Is reinforcement required for anti-crack or fire resistance?
Where required are spacers and chairs shown/specified?
